scope: All 20 maintained official ES editions sources, plus the exact Splunk App for SOAR 8.7.0 and SOAR Export 8.7.0 records used to qualify ES pairings.

sourceInventory.method: Each maintained ES URL was fetched directly and compared with the existing scoped evidence. A fetched source was not treated as a verified claim; the checks below record the bounded claims reviewed on October 3.

claimChecks.qualification: The release note names Premier and says the feature is on for eligible users, but it does not define Essentials entitlement or remove pairing and permission prerequisites.
claimChecks.followUp: Preserve this side of the conflict with the agent table until Splunk publishes an authoritative edition clarification.

claimChecks.section: Agent compatibility table; Connector Builder, AI SOC Analyst, Malware Reversing and Phishing rows
claimChecks.qualification: The table lists Connector Builder for Essentials and Premier, AI SOC Analyst at ES 8.6+, and Malware/Phishing at ES 8.5+. Task-specific pages contain different minimums. Workflow grouping is not entitlement.
claimChecks.followUp: Keep all three discrepancies visible and require target-stack confirmation.

claimChecks.section: 8.7 Premier column; Triage and Guided Response enhancements
claimChecks.qualification: The matrix describes enhancements, not the base feature entitlement, and does not supersede the separately versioned 8.6 task guide.
claimChecks.followUp: Keep the enhancement scope separate from base availability.

claimChecks.section: Guided Response prerequisites and supported editions
claimChecks.productVersionEnvironment: Enterprise Security 8.6+; Cloud Platform 10.2+; Essentials or Premier; paired SOAR
claimChecks.qualification: This is 8.6 task evidence and cannot by itself establish the exact 8.7 enhancement boundary.
claimChecks.followUp: Continue to label the source version and preserve the 8.7 ambiguity.

claimChecks.section: Splunk SOAR compatibility and regional availability tables
claimChecks.productVersionEnvironment: Enterprise Security 8.7; Cloud and customer-managed pairings
claimChecks.qualification: Enterprise 9.4.0 through 9.4.2 remain excluded. Region, edition entitlement and authorization are separate from pairing.
claimChecks.followUp: Keep exact Cloud/on-premises rows; do not infer a pairing from independently current releases.

claimChecks.section: Automation Builder availability, requirements and restricted-environment note
claimChecks.productVersionEnvironment: Cloud Platform 10.1+; ES 8.6+; paired SOAR Cloud
claimChecks.qualification: The task is unavailable on FedRAMP SOAR stacks. Platform hosting or FIPS does not establish feature authorization.
claimChecks.followUp: Retain deployment, pairing, permission and restricted-environment qualifications.

claimChecks.qualification: The overview lists activity, workload and ingest options, while the model FAQ names Cloud Platform for activity eligibility. A public pricing page is not a quote or entitlement record.
claimChecks.followUp: Keep deployment and contract eligibility unresolved.

claimChecks.section: Essentials and Premier trial periods and expiry behavior
claimChecks.qualification: The guide documents 30-day Essentials and 90-day Premier trials. Trial terms do not establish SOAR pairing or universal commercial eligibility.

claimChecks.productVersionEnvironment: Enterprise Security Premier; native UEBA feature
claimChecks.qualification: Native UEBA is Premier-only and is not offered standalone or as an Essentials add-on. This does not establish scope for every related product.

claimChecks.section: Exposure Analytics capabilities and coming-soon labels
claimChecks.productVersionEnvironment: Exposure Analytics; continuous posture metrics and Entity Profiling
claimChecks.qualification: The two capabilities remain labelled coming soon and are not treated as generally available.
claimChecks.followUp: Keep release-stage labels until product documentation changes.

claimChecks.productVersionEnvironment: Splunk App for SOAR 8.7.0 with ES 8.7.0 or 8.6.1
claimChecks.qualification: The table names ES 8.7.0, not ES 8.7.1. Independent release numbers do not prove an unlisted pairing.
claimChecks.followUp: Keep ES 8.7.1 pairing unconfirmed until an exact row is published.

claimChecks.section: 8.7.0 release date and fixed issue PAPP-38389
claimChecks.qualification: Export is a separate app with a separate compatibility matrix; its release does not establish an ES or App for SOAR pairing.
claimChecks.followUp: Preserve the separate Export record and compatibility check.

boundedBacklog: Connector Builder: Essentials entitlement versus the 8.7.1 Premier release-note label
Guided Response: base entitlement versus the 8.7 Premier enhancement grouping
AI SOC Analyst: ES 8.6+ aggregate-table floor versus ES 8.7+ task-guide floor
Malware Reversing and Phishing: ES 8.5+ aggregate-table floor versus ES 8.6+ task-guide floor
Activity-based pricing: ES overview label versus Cloud Platform eligibility wording

validationOutcomes.detail: All 20 maintained ES URLs were fetched; no source change requiring an edition-data correction was found.

validationOutcomes.check: Synchronization gates and automated regression suite
validationOutcomes.detail: All three synchronization checks passed; node --test tests/*.test.cjs passed 79 of 79 tests on the reconciled source.
The canonical ?view=es-editions route loaded the comparison. A fresh ?preview=es-editions tab loaded the same content and canonicalized to the public view route after initialization.

validationOutcomes.check: Live conflicts, themes and fixed actions
validationOutcomes.detail: The live page retained all five evidence questions, including both Connector Builder statements and both Guided Response scopes. Default and theme=cisco routes loaded; Copy comparison link, Print / save PDF and snapshot actions remained present.
Keyboard activation changed the URL to #edition-comparison. The browser did not expose a reliable focus-target confirmation, so focus placement was not marked passed.

validationOutcomes.check: Actual PDF, downloaded HTML reopen and narrow-screen browser
validationOutcomes.detail: No native PDF/page inspection or viewport-resize surface was available. The snapshot was prepared but the browser download channel timed out, so no independent HTML reopen was claimed.
